name: Knowgrph Agent
description: Agent-readable discovery, published-document retrieval, and WebMCP-ready metadata surface for Knowgrph.

supportedInterfaces.description: Primary machine interface for read-only discovery and source-file document access.
Published source-files index and storage-backed document read surface.

skills.name: Search Knowgrph Source Files
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host needs to search published Knowgrph Source Files and return stable document IDs for the `fetch` tool. Call this first for OpenAI Deep Research-style retrieval, Claude, Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, BytePlus ModelArk, and generic MCP clients.
examples: Search Knowgrph Source Files for renderer architecture.

skills.name: Fetch Knowgrph Source File
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host needs the complete published Knowgrph Source File for an ID returned by `search`. Returns markdown as both `content` and `text` for OpenAI, Claude, Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, BytePlus ModelArk, and generic MCP clients.
examples: Fetch the Knowgrph Source File id returned by search.

skills.name: List Source Files
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host needs the published Knowgrph Source Files index as markdown.
examples: List the published Knowgrph Source Files.

skills.name: Read Source File
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host knows a published Knowgrph canonical path and needs that Editor Workspace markdown content. Defaults to the canonical docs workspace when workspaceId is omitted.
examples: Read the published source file for docs/getting-started.md.

skills.name: Read Shared Document
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host has a Knowgrph share token or public Knowgrph share/document URL and needs the published markdown content.
examples: Read the Knowgrph shared document behind this share URL.

skills.name: Inspect Shared Document Structure
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host has a Knowgrph share token or public Knowgrph share/document URL and needs frontmatter/body structure without mutating the document.
examples: Inspect the structure of this Knowgrph shared document.

skills.name: Start Storyboard Run
skills.description: Create a dual-persisted StoryboardRun and start the Storyboard Studio OS orchestration loop.

skills.name: Advance Storyboard Run Lane
skills.description: Advance a StoryboardRun to the next lane, enforcing iteration bounds and gate state.

skills.name: Submit Strybord Research Query
skills.description: Record a research-lane request for a StoryboardRun.

skills.name: Propose Strybord Budget
skills.description: Record a provider-neutral budget estimate before paid render.

skills.name: Request Human Gate
skills.description: Open or update a human-in-the-loop Budget, Proof, Publish, Render, or Compliance gate.

skills.name: Get Human Gate Decision
skills.description: Read the current decision for a human-in-the-loop gate.

skills.name: Enqueue Strybord Render
skills.description: Create a render job placeholder only after the Budget gate is approved.

skills.name: Publish Strybord Asset
skills.description: Publish a render artifact only after Proof and Publish gates are approved.

skills.name: Settle Strybord Payout
skills.description: Settle the creator revenue share at the default 80/20 split through payment-worker ownership.

skills.name: Get Storyboard Run State
skills.description: Read the D1-authoritative StoryboardRun state and gate/payout summary.

skills.name: Inspect Agent Surface
skills.description: Use this when an MCP Apps-capable host or generic MCP client needs to inspect Knowgrph agent-ready discovery, MCP Apps readiness, OpenAPI, and skill metadata.
examples: Show the Knowgrph agent discovery metadata.
